variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand, a substantial design revision of the attached Chinese game title logo. The user likes its strong calligraphic style but finds the monochrome palette cheap and the overall design too ordinary. Create one new, distinctive, professionally art-directed title logo, not a minor recolor. Exact text is ONLY "逆转五丈原": five correct simplified Chinese characters, read in that order. Reference image is a direction reference, not a rigid shape template: preserve the forceful readable Chinese brush-calligraphy family, redesign individual strokes and composition with recognizable character skeletons. The game is a mature Three Kingdoms interactive historical drama about entering historical tragedies and reversing fate through choices, reasoning and rescue. Convey human resolve and the weight of history. Detailed tangible materials INSIDE the lettering, clear bold silhouette, controlled dry-brush edges, beautiful negative spaces. No generic font typesetting. No separate landscape or character illustration. No English, slogan, labels, additional seals with words, mockup sheets, duplicate logos, watermarks, swords, dragons, wings, cartoon, neon magic, explosive fire, excessive particles, plastic CGI bevels, gold casino lettering, esports badges. Output an isolated finished logo on genuine transparent background, wide canvas, no background rectangle, all strokes safely inside frame with 8 percent margin. Prioritize excellent readability when reduced. Direction 1 — AGED GOLD AND VERMILION, bold horizontal cinematic brush wordmark. All five characters sit in a single line, but hand-composed on a subtly rising baseline with the first two slightly taller. Letter faces are richly luminous restrained aged gold leaf, pale warm gold highlights, deep bronze in subtle surface recesses, fine irregular rubbed metal grain and sparse old vermilion lacquer showing beneath worn edges. NOT flat yellow. The long lower stroke of 逆 sweeps left then decisively reverses up toward 转, part of the actual calligraphy, colored dark cinnabar red fading into burnished gold at its rising tip. This stroke is the single memorable graphic signature, not a detached underline swoosh. Sharply controlled thick-to-thin tension, restrained asymmetry, monumental historical cinema title treatment. Most of the title should remain bright enough to show on a dark game menu. Do not add a ring, lamp, seal or extra icon.
